items.label: SemiFive press release: SEMIFIVE Accelerates Growth with 97% YoY Revenue Surge in (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: H1 2026 gross margin rose 18.7 percentage points year over ye

set.signal: H1 2026 gross margin rose 18.7 percentage points year over year from 11.9% to 30.6%, and operating margin improved 47.0 percentage points to -11.5%. The mass production business is entering a full-scale ramp-up phase on continued follow-on POs for vision AI, on-device AI and data center AI chips. At the same time the company is expanding its new ASIC development pipeline, with rapidly growing demand from customers across North America, Europe and Asia for 3D-IC-based high-performance AI semiconductor projects. CEO Brandon Cho: with backlog and production volumes progressively translating into revenue and an expanding pipeline of new ASIC development opportunities, "we expect our growth momentum to strengthen further in the second half of the year."

items.reason: The 3D-IC demand from North America/Europe/Asia is tied in the release to the new ASIC development pipeline, not to the mass-production ramp; the entry attached it to mass production
items.evidence: At the same time, the company is expanding its new ASIC development pipeline, with rapidly growing demand from customers across North America, Europe, and Asia for high-performance AI semiconductor projects based on 3D-IC technology.
